items.title: Three Things NBA Preview: Los Angeles Clippers
items.author: Last Night In Basketball
items.body_excerpt: Hey there, Last Night In Basketballers — I am, as I do every year, re-appropriating the Three Things I Noticed on League Pass format to preview the upcoming season. Instead of three things I noticed, it’ll be something more along the lines of three things I’m looking forward to,…
